Sandbox_PZLinux_AcceptAlternateCurrency_: Accepts deposits/payments using both currency families. Withdrawals and change always use the selected currency. Disable to accept only the selected family. Existing items are never deleted.
Sandbox_PZLinux_StartingBalanceMin_toolt: Only new accounts. Saved balances are preserved. If minimum exceeds maximum, minimum is used.
Sandbox_PZLinux_StartingBalanceMax_toolt: Inclusive upper limit for new accounts. Existing accounts are not reset.
Sandbox_PZLinux_MaxCashTransaction_toolt: Maximum base units for one physical cash deposit/withdrawal. Split larger amounts into transactions.

Sandbox_PZLinux_RepairTime_tooltip: Timed-action units used by the game. Default preserves the previous repair duration.
Sandbox_PZLinux_MailMaxHours_tooltip: Maximum delay before reputation adjustment. The result never falls below the configured minimum. Existing scheduled mail keeps its deadline.
Sandbox_PZLinux_DarkWebMaxOffers_tooltip: Applies on the next catalog refresh, up to the available definitions. Saved paid deliveries are retained.
Sandbox_PZLinux_DarkWebDeliveryTheftChan: Percentage for deliveries marked as eligible for theft. 0 disables theft; 100 always steals eligible deliveries.
Sandbox_PZLinux_TradingVolatilityMultipl: 0 freezes random price movement; saved history and holdings remain. Contract impact is controlled separately.
